links.outcome: Contouring accuracy and time for residents with AI assistance versus fully manual delineation
links.effect: AI-assisted CTV median DSC 0.745 vs 0.703, HD 20.03 vs 21.55 mm, MDA 2.57 vs 3.06 mm (all P<0.05); CTV time cut ~43.2%, OAR time ~56.2%.
links.quote: AI-assisted CTV and OARs delineation for PORT significantly improves the accuracy and efficiency in the real-world setting, compared with pure AI auto-segmentation or fully manual delineation by junior oncologists.

links.outcome: Performance of clinicians using AI in workflow versus standalone AI and manual delineation
links.effect: AI-assisted CTV had lower HD and MDA and higher DSC than comparators (DSC 0.745 vs 0.703, P<0.05); time shortened 43.2% for CTV and 56.2% for OARs.
links.quote: Our findings demonstrated that the implementation of AI-assisted technology could lead to significantly improved contouring accuracy, greater interobserver consistency, as well as considerable time savings.

links.outcome: Accuracy of manual and AI-assisted contouring reported separately by center
links.effect: Accuracy varied by center; the lower-level hospital (LH) gained most with AI assistance, DSC 0.753 vs 0.639 manual (p<0.05).
links.quote: The accuracy of AI-assisted delineation group in the LH group is greatly improved compared with that of the simple manual contour group (DSC: 0.753 VS 0.639), p<0.05).

unlisted_practices: AI-assisted contour editing by residents to reduce inter-observer variability and time in radiotherapy planning

links.quote: AI-assisted delineation achieved significantly higher accuracy compared to unmodified AI auto-contouring and fully manual delineation by radiation oncologists, with median HD, MDA, and DCS values of 20.03 vs. 21.55 mm, 2.57 vs. 3.06 mm, 0.745 vs. 0.703 (all P<0.05) for CTV, respectively.

links.effect: AI-assisted CTV delineation improved HD, MDA, and DSC versus comparator: 20.03 vs 21.55; 2.57 vs 3.06; 0.745 vs 0.703; P<0.05.
links.quote: Compared with the GT standard, the AI-assisted CTV delineation had a significantly lower median HD (20.03 [IQR: 14.50, 27.01] vs. 21.55 [IQR: 16.11, 30.51], P< 0.05), and smaller MDA (2.57 [IQR: 2.03, 3.52] vs. 3.06 [IQR: 2.32, 4.11], P< 0.05), higher median DSC (0.745 [IQR: 0.715, 0.784] vs. 0.703 [IQR: 0.656, 0.750], P< 0.05).

links.effect: AI-assisted OAR DSC was >0.8; left/right lungs, heart, and liver DSC >0.9; all P<0.05 versus manual contours.
links.quote: Additionally, the accuracy of the AI-assisted delineation significantly outperformed fully manual contours by junior radiation oncologists, with DSC greater than 0.8, among which the left and right lungs, heart and liver performed better, with DSC greater than 0.9 (all P< 0.05).

links.effect: CTV and OAR contouring efficiency improved by 43.2% (5.34 ± 1.75 minutes) and 56.2% (17.73 ± 4.49 minutes); both P<0.001.
links.quote: Taken together, we observed a significant improvement in CTV and OARs contouring efficiency by approximately 43.2% (5.34 ± 1.75 minutes) and 56.2% (17.73 ± 4.49 minutes), respectively (both P< 0.001).
